about.taste_title:
Taste the food,
taste the tea,
taste the life
about.taste_body_1: The characters "品品" mean to taste, and taste again. We believe every bite of food deserves to be savored slowly, every cup of tea carries the rhythm of culture, and every moment spent at our café is an opportunity to taste life itself.
about.taste_body_2: From our first store in Taichung to Nakameguro in Tokyo, we insist on using the finest ingredients, made to order, delivering crispy-outside, QQ-soft-inside eggcakes to every guest.

craft.label: Craftsmanship
craft.title: The making of an eggcake
craft.intro: Every Pin Pin eggcake is a work of art, made to order. From batter to finish, we insist on the warmth and quality of handcrafted perfection.

batter.title: The batter
batter.body: Our batter is made fresh daily using premium flour, free-range eggs, and our secret blend of ingredients perfected over years. The precise ratio creates our signature crispy-outside, QQ-soft-inside texture.

pour.title: The pour
pour.body: Each mold is carefully preheated to the perfect temperature. The batter is poured with practiced precision — not too much, not too little — ensuring every egg in the waffle is perfectly formed.

flip.title: The flip
flip.body: Timing is everything. Our artisans flip the mold at exactly the right moment, distributing the batter evenly and creating that characteristic golden color on both sides.

finish.title: The finish
finish.body: Served hot and fresh, each eggcake is torn from the mold revealing the perfect honeycomb structure inside. Best enjoyed within minutes, when the contrast between crisp shell and soft center is at its peak.

low_sugar.title: Low sugar
low_sugar.body: Reduced sugar without sacrificing flavor. Sweetness from quality ingredients, not excess sugar.

made_to_order.title: Made to order
made_to_order.body: Every eggcake is made fresh when you order. No pre-made, no reheated — just fresh.

ingredients.title: Premium ingredients
ingredients.body: Free-range eggs, high-grade flour, and carefully sourced flavor ingredients from around the world.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: How Pin Pin Café collects, uses, and protects the information you share with us through this website.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body:
When you send us a message through the contact form, we receive your name, email address, subject, and message. Franchise inquiries also include your company name, contact person, phone number, country, and budget range.

When online pickup ordering is available and you place an order, we receive your name, mobile number, the items and options you chose, your pickup store and time, and the e-invoice details you provide.

We do not ask for information we do not need, and we never sell your information.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body:
We use contact details to reply to your message and, for franchise inquiries, to discuss opening a store with you.

We use order details to prepare your order, hand it to you at the right store and time, and issue the electronic invoice that Taiwanese law requires.

sections.title: What is stored on your device
sections.body:
This site does not use advertising cookies or third-party tracking.

If you start a pickup order, your basket, chosen store, and pickup time are saved in your own browser so they survive a page reload. Clearing your browser data removes them.

sections.title: Who else handles your information
sections.body:
This website is hosted by Vercel. Messages from the contact form are delivered by Resend, our email provider. The store map is served by Google Maps when it is enabled, which means Google receives the request that loads the map.

When online payment launches, payments will be processed by ECPay. Card details go directly to the payment provider; we never see or store them.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body:
We keep inquiry messages for as long as we need them to answer you and to keep a record of our conversation.

We keep order and invoice records for as long as Taiwanese tax and accounting rules require, and then delete them.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.body: You can ask us what information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email us and we will respond as quickly as we can.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: If we change how we handle your information, we will update this page and change the date above.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: The terms that apply when you use the Pin Pin Café website and order from us online.

sections.title: About these terms
sections.body: By using this website you accept these terms. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the site.

sections.title: Menu and store information
sections.body:
We try to keep menus, prices, opening hours, and store details accurate and current, but they can change without notice, and not every item is available at every store.

Prices are shown in New Taiwan dollars for our Taiwan stores and in Japanese yen for our Japan store.

sections.title: Allergies and ingredients
sections.body: Our eggcakes contain egg, wheat, and dairy, and are made in kitchens that also handle nuts and other allergens, so we cannot guarantee any item is free of a given allergen. If you have a food allergy, please ask our staff before you order.

sections.title: Online orders and pickup
sections.body:
Where online pickup ordering is available, your order is a request to buy that becomes final when payment is confirmed and you receive a pickup number.

Please collect your order at the store and time you chose. Food quality suffers if it sits, and we may not be able to hold an uncollected order.

If we cannot fulfil an order, for example when an item sells out or a store closes unexpectedly, we will cancel it and refund you.

sections.title: Payment
sections.body: Online payments are handled by our payment provider, not by this website. Refunds are returned through the same method you paid with.

sections.title: Our content
sections.body: The Pin Pin Café name, logo, photography, and text on this site belong to us. Please do not copy or reuse them commercially without our written permission.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body: We provide this website as it is, and we cannot promise it will always be available or free of errors. Nothing in these terms limits any rights you have under consumer protection law.

sections.title: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Taiwan.
